title: Signed line unit presentation graphs
statement: Let p,q,r be unit presentations [def-pur-signed-line-pullback-unit-presentation]. Suppose a binary operation on their target sheaves agrees on unit sections with a source operation. For any sheaf Z and source sections x:Z→S, y:Z→S′, z:Z→S″ satisfying z=op(x,y), their transported maps from L(Z) satisfy the corresponding target operation equation. Likewise a target constant agreeing with the source constant on units carries every source constant graph to that target constant graph.

source.place: Tags 03D2, 03D3, 03EL and 0FNY; for derived localization use derived.tex Tags 06YU, 07A4 and 015F. Specialization of the Powers and duals paragraph of the current blueprint.

proof.text: Use the canonical presentation of the test sheaf inverse image and its hom_ext. Both transported graph maps have the same value on every unit section by map_unit and the assumed binary or constant normalization.

lean.statement:
theorem binary_graph
    (p : SheafPullbackUnitPresentation (F := F) S T)
    (q : SheafPullbackUnitPresentation (F := F) S' T')
    (r : SheafPullbackUnitPresentation (F := F) S'' T'')
    (op : ∀ V, S.obj.obj V → S'.obj.obj V → S''.obj.obj V)
    (b : T ⊗ T' ⟶ T'')
    (hu : ∀ V x y, b.hom.app (F.op.obj V)
      (p.unit.hom.app V x, q.unit.hom.app V y) = r.unit.hom.app V (op V x y))
    (Z : Sheaf J (Type (max u v w))) (x : Z ⟶ S) (y : Z ⟶ S') (z : Z ⟶ S'')
    (hz : ∀ V a, z.hom.app V a = op V (x.hom.app V a) (y.hom.app V a)) :
    (sheafPullback F (Type (max u v w)) J K).map z ≫ r.iso.inv =
      CartesianMonoidalCategory.lift
        ((sheafPullback F (Type (max u v w)) J K).map x ≫ p.iso.inv)
        ((sheafPullback F (Type (max u v w)) J K).map y ≫ q.iso.inv) ≫ b
